plan.title: Held PR line cannot be purchased

steps.note: Enable the hold-status behavior required by the case.
Use the Open tab where purchasable PRs are listed.
Select the prepared PR line that is on hold so Purchase Items can be inspected.
Reveal the product's explanation for why the held line cannot be purchased.

args.text: Please fill the remarks to continue!

steps.note: Assert the required-remark message shown for the blocked held-line action.
Assert that the held line disables purchasing.
Try the blocked action and require evidence that it cannot be clicked.
